name: goodbyematrix-citizenship-costs
description: Citizenship by investment (second passport) cost estimates for 9 programmes, per family, with eligibility checks.

interface.longDescription:
Citizenship by investment (CBI), often called a second passport or economic citizenship, lets a family obtain a new citizenship through a government contribution or a qualifying investment. This app answers the first question most people have: what would it cost for my family?

What it does
- Lists the 9 programmes covered: St Kitts and Nevis, Antigua and Barbuda, Dominica, Grenada, Saint Lucia, Vanuatu, Sao Tome and Principe, Nauru and Argentina, with starting amount, route (contribution or investment), processing time and number of visa-free destinations.
- Calculates an indicative total for your actual family (main applicant, partner, children, parents, grandparents, siblings): government contribution or investment, fees, professional fees, payment phases and total in USD, for one programme or for all 9 side by side.
- Checks eligibility: if you mention nationalities or countries of birth, it shows which family members a programme excludes.
- Creates a personal link to the programme's calculator on goodbyematrix.com with your family already filled in; there you enter your contact details and request the exact, itemised cost breakdown by e-mail. Nothing is sent or stored unless you send it yourself.

Who it is for
Individuals and families researching a second citizenship, and advisers who need quick, comparable figures.

Limitations
- Figures are rounded indicative estimates (totals to the nearest USD 1,000) based on the programme rules; they become binding only after a pre-check. This is not legal or tax advice.
- Covers citizenship by investment only, not residency-by-investment or golden visa programmes.
- Answers in English or German.

Provided by GoodbyeMatrix (goodbyematrix.com).
defaultPrompt: How much would a second passport cost for me, my wife and our two kids?
Compare citizenship by investment programmes in the Caribbean for a family of four.
Which citizenship by investment programme is the cheapest for a single applicant?

positive.description: Single programme quote for a family of four
positive.prompt: Using GoodbyeMatrix, what does citizenship by investment in St. Kitts and Nevis cost for me (45), my wife (43) and our two children (14 and 10)?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_cbi_quote for St. Kitts and Nevis and returns the indicative total in USD with the split into government contribution, fees and professional fees, confirms that all 4 family members are included, and gives the link to request the detailed cost breakdown on goodbyematrix.com.

positive.description: Compare all programmes for one applicant
positive.prompt: Using GoodbyeMatrix, compare all citizenship by investment programmes for a single applicant aged 40 and show me the three lowest totals.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_cbi_quote without a programme, receives indicative figures for all 9 programmes and names the three lowest indicative totals in USD with the programme names.

positive.prompt: Using GoodbyeMatrix, list all citizenship by investment programmes it prices, with the starting amount and the approval time for each.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls list_cbi_programs and lists the 9 programmes with the starting amount in USD for a single applicant and the approximate approval time for each.

positive.description: Link for the exact cost breakdown
positive.prompt: Using GoodbyeMatrix, give me the link for the exact cost breakdown for Grenada for my family of four: parents 45 and 43, children 14 and 10.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls request_cost_breakdown_link and returns a link to the Grenada calculator page on goodbyematrix.com with the family filled in; the user enters contact details on the page; nothing is sent, stored or submitted.

positive.description: Eligibility check for an adult dependent child
positive.prompt: Using GoodbyeMatrix, check whether my son (27, a full-time student who is financially dependent on me) can be included in a Grenada citizenship by investment application with me (52) and my wife (50), and what it would cost in total.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_cbi_quote for Grenada with the son marked as dependent and financially dependent, shows that all 3 family members are included, and returns the indicative total in USD with the link to the cost breakdown.
